role: RAD-seq is a population-ancestry and trait-history-localization instrument, not an unconditional species-tree or adaptation instrument

primary_products.R1_focal_population_ancestry: primary RAD product for P01/P02/M01: within-lineage population structure, ancestry, admixture/network sensitivity and trait-history localization
primary_products.R2_all_japan_sensitivity: secondary strict-shared-locus topology/network sensitivity for P03/P04 only if a single production protocol and shared-locus gate survive the pilot
primary_products.R3_mixed_ploidy_overlay: within-cytotype or ploidy-aware population inference overlaid on the target-capture species backbone; no pooled diploid matrix across ploidies
primary_products.R4_m01_selection_support: RAD may estimate population structure and the demographic/background null for M01 E3, but RAD-only selection outliers are not final E3 evidence

stage_A_enzyme_screen.rule: screen at least three candidate rare/common-cutter combinations on one qualified DNA template per anchor concept; use shallow sequencing and fragment-size/library-complexity diagnostics
stage_A_enzyme_screen.candidate_pair_policy: enzyme pairs are not frozen in v1; choose candidates using available in-silico digestion and empirical plant ddRAD considerations, then freeze the winning pair before production
stage_A_enzyme_screen.size_selection_policy: the size window is empirical and frozen with the enzyme pair; do not retune it after biological outcomes are visible

stage_B_reproducibility_screen.rule: carry the best two candidate protocols into the full 16-template anchor set and add cross-batch technical library repeats on preregistered sentinels
metrics: retained reads after demultiplexing and trimming
usable locus count after equal-depth downsampling
median and dispersion of depth per locus
shared-locus recovery within focal pairs and across anchors
heterozygosity/depth signatures of paralog or homeolog collapse

pilot.single_protocol_viability_gate: one protocol is used across the full production panel only if all mandatory anchors remain usable and the strict shared-locus product is not driven by one genome-size or ploidy class
pilot.stratification_fallback: if the single-protocol gate fails, split protocol strata (for example core Japan38 versus M01 Ryukyu) and prohibit concatenating different RAD protocols into one SNP matrix; retain target capture as the cross-stratum species scaffold

dna_and_library.preferred_tissue: fresh or rapidly silica-dried leaf; old herbarium DNA is not mixed into the primary production batch unless a separately validated degraded-DNA protocol is frozen
dna_and_library.indexing: unique sample indexing; ambiguous index assignments are discarded
dna_and_library.read_configuration: same paired-end read configuration for the entire production stratum; exact read length is frozen after pilot
dna_and_library.pcr_rule: minimize and freeze PCR cycle count after pilot; if a UMI/degenerate-base duplicate scheme is adopted it must be applied uniformly within a production stratum
dna_and_library.batch_randomization: taxa, populations, phenotype states, cytotype classes and M01 lineages are spread across extraction, digestion/ligation, PCR and sequencing batches; no focal population may be confounded with one batch or lane
dna_and_library.production_technical_duplicates: 5-10 percent of libraries; selected before outcomes and placed in different library/sequencing batches; technical duplicates never increase biological n
dna_and_library.resequence_rule: resequence low-yield samples only when library complexity and identity QC indicate a technical yield failure; do not replace biologically inconvenient samples

sequencing_depth.depth_rule: downsample pilot reads to build saturation curves for usable loci, depth distribution and technical-replicate concordance; freeze a production reads-per-sample target before trait-history analysis
sequencing_depth.balance_rule: pool libraries equimolarly after QC and monitor read-count imbalance by taxon, population, genome-size and batch

raw_qc: contamination and gross depth outlier screening
bioinformatics.primary_assembly: Stacks 2 de novo assembly because no single lineage-matched nuclear reference is assumed across Japan38

stacks_parameter_freeze.optimization_basis: outcome-blind pilot/technical metrics using r80-style broadly replicated loci, replicate concordance and paralog burden
stacks_parameter_freeze.n_rule: test n near the selected M (M-1, M, M+1 where nonnegative) rather than accepting defaults without evaluation
stacks_parameter_freeze.freeze_timing: freeze primary m/M/n and genotype filters before inspecting P01-P05 trait-history outcomes
stacks_parameter_freeze.sensitivity: retain adjacent parameter sets as an assembly sensitivity rather than reporting only one optimized matrix

bioinformatics.reference_sensitivity: reference-aligned Stacks/gstacks is allowed only for lineage-matched or sufficiently close qualified nuclear references; do not map all Cirsium to one distant reference and interpret mapping failure as biology
bioinformatics.missing_data_policy: do not select one universal missing-data threshold post hoc; construct predeclared analysis-specific occupancy matrices and report how results change across them
paralog_homeolog_filters: excess observed heterozygosity relative to the relevant cytotype/population
allele counts incompatible with the recorded ploidy/inheritance model

focal_population_matrix.purpose: P01/P02 and within-lineage M01 population ancestry
focal_population_matrix.occupancy_target: optimize and report broadly replicated within-population loci (r80-style primary sensitivity) while retaining a less stringent prespecified comparison
focal_population_matrix.one_snp_per_locus_matrix: required for methods assuming approximate marker independence
focal_population_matrix.haplotype_or_locus_matrix: retained for distance/network and sequence-based sensitivity where appropriate

all_japan_strict_matrix.gate: build only if the pilot supports one production protocol and shared-locus recovery remains adequate across phylogenetic, genome-size and ploidy classes
all_japan_strict_matrix.claim_ceiling: secondary sensitivity/network; never the definitive Japanese species tree
all_japan_strict_matrix.fallback: if shared loci collapse with divergence, cancel the all-Japan RAD topology product and map focal RAD population clusters onto the frozen target-capture species scaffold

mixed_ploidy_matrices.diploid: Stacks discrete genotypes may be used after standard QC
mixed_ploidy_matrices.polyploid: use allele read depth and a ploidy-aware probabilistic approach such as polyRAD or another preregistered genotype-likelihood/dosage method when the inheritance model is supportable
mixed_ploidy_matrices.unknown_cytotype: exclude from pooled dosage-dependent inference until cytotype is resolved
mixed_ploidy_matrices.cross_ploidy: no single diploid genotype caller or dosage matrix across mixed cytotypes; cross-ploidy organismal history remains anchored by target capture

minimum_outputs: pairwise differentiation and within-population diversity with missingness sensitivity
distance/network representation where reticulation is plausible
population_and_history_inference.trait_history_rule: trait states are never used to tune RAD assembly or sample filters; ancestry/network products are frozen first, then P01-P05 historical discriminators are evaluated
population_and_history_inference.species_tree_rule: Moreyra/Comp1061 target capture remains the primary cross-species scaffold unless a separate future contract explicitly replaces it

rad_allowed: candidate-region context if the candidate is independently nominated from E2 and the locus is demonstrably callable
rad_not_sufficient: claim of a selective sweep without independent locus/reference qualification
claim that a pollinator or climate variable is the selective agent
m01_selection_boundary.promotion_rule: if E2 nominates a replicable mechanism, final E3 candidate-region evidence should preferentially use a lineage-aware non-RAD confirmation route such as targeted capture/amplicon resequencing or qualified low-pass/whole-genome resequencing; RAD remains the population-structure background
m01_selection_boundary.dropout_audit: test whether locus presence/missingness differs systematically among populations or phenotype states; a candidate signal coupled to restriction-site dropout is not admitted as selection evidence

stop_rules: single protocol fails genome-size/ploidy anchors -> stratify protocols or abandon all-Japan RAD matrix
population or phenotype confounded with library batch -> no biological population comparison until a balanced design is restored
technical repeats fail the frozen concordance gate -> rebuild/resequence affected batch before inference
shared-locus collapse with divergence -> no all-Japan RAD topology claim
cytotype unresolved -> no pooled dosage-dependent mixed-ploidy analysis
cut-site dropout correlated with candidate population/phenotype -> no RAD-only selection claim
RAD result conflicts with target-capture scaffold -> investigate reticulation/dropout; do not silently replace the species scaffold
trait outcome may not be used to retune m/M/n, missingness, MAF or locus filters
